<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=66712 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=not_planned confidence=high -->
Thanks for checking placement before duplicating the prior work. The described transport scope and use of the existing platform interface are useful.

This is an automated hermes-sweeper review. The in-tree placement is not planned under the standing third-party integration policy:

- `AGENTS.md:797-813` requires plugins for someone else's product or vendor service to ship as standalone repositories, not as new directories in this repository's `plugins/` tree. This is a maintenance/coupling decision, not a judgment on the adapter quality.
- The supported route is already documented: `website/docs/developer-guide/adding-platform-adapters.md:9-13` and `:31-39` describe a no-core-change platform plugin installed under `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
- The referenced #58952 was withdrawn by its author and contains no maintainer approval for an in-tree exception.

Please publish the Instagram adapter as a standalone installable Hermes plugin repository, using the documented `ctx.register_platform()` contract, and share it in `#plugins-skills-and-skins`.

---
*Closed as not-planned per standing maintainer policy (`in-tree-provider-integration`). This is a design-direction decision, not a code-quality judgment — see the Contribution Rubric in `AGENTS.md` for what the project is looking for. If you believe this policy was misapplied to your change, comment here and a maintainer will take a look.*
